scope: All 273 GT IDs in 25 DanceTrack val videos; descriptions and validation only, no QA generation, tracker or training.
raw_data: read only; original GT and language annotations unchanged
authorization: User explicitly agreed to strong-VLM GT-crop appearance supplementation after Stage 2 gap report.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct
model.reason: Official dense 32B vision-language model, separate from evaluated Qwen2.5-VL-7B and eventual Qwen3-VL-8B filter.

crops.five_temporal_bins: span first..last GT-visible frames; best unused quality frame in each bin; generation bins 0,2,4, held-out bins 1,3
crops.quality: sqrt(box area / max area for this ID) * in-frame box-area fraction * (1 - maximum intersection / target box area)
crops.fallback: relax spacing if bin has no unused spaced candidate; then choose unused global best if bin empty; record relaxation. Never reuse a frame between generation and validation.
crops.native_crop: clipped only when reading pixels; no change to GT boxes; preserve aspect ratio, resize only for gallery

gallery.labels: P01 etc assigned using seed42+stable stage/video/frame key; raw GT ID never included in model images/text

anchor.selection: best-quality held-out frame with >=3 seconds remaining; ties earlier frame
anchor.meaning: one verified timepoint only; do not extrapolate to a contiguous unique interval

validation.global: phrase matches exactly target ID and no uncertain IDs among all same-video GT identities
validation.local: at preselected anchor, full-frame plus every GT-present crop matches exactly target and no uncertain IDs
validation.accept: both global and local pass, valid phrase, anchor geometric quality thresholds pass
validation.parse_failure: retain raw output and reject; no content-directed retries or label repairs
validation.limitation: same-model held-out visual consistency is not independent human verification; indistinguishable/unclear people may be rejected

visual_review.selection: one deterministic accepted ID per video if any; otherwise one generated ID; plus 5 seed42 rejected cases if available
visual_review.purpose: agent checks facts and ambiguity, not a population error-rate estimate; final user review is still needed

stop: Stop and report after optional Stage 2 supplementation; Stage 3 remains unstarted.
